summary: The PR adds a new attribute `refit_time_` to measure the time taken to refit the best model, which resolves the linked issue. The implementation is straightforward and does not introduce any obvious issues.

issues.description: The new attribute `refit_time_` is added to both `GridSearchCV` and `RandomizedSearchCV`, but the docstring for `BaseSearchCV` should also be updated to reflect this new attribute.
